items.markdown: Fig. 14. Path of three sampled latent states (a) $x_2$, (b) $x_{37}$ and (c) $x_{93}$, and of the sampled parameters (d) $r$, (e) $K$ and (f) $\zeta$, over 100000 PMH iterations based on $N=200$ particles by using a simple sampling–importance resampling filter—the one-dimensional state did not call for Rao–Blackwellization: note also the effect of the adaptive MCMC proposal for $\theta=(r,\zeta,K)$, set up to start at iteration 5000, which is particularly visible on the mixing of parameters $K$; the most noticeable property of the algorithm is the remarkable mixing of the chain, in spite of the high total dimension of the sampled state; each iteration involves a proposal of $(X_{1:T},\theta)$ of dimension 103
